title: Radworks (Radicle) governance capture — $14.40M timelock, no guardian, treasury undelegated; +$0.36M Drips admin
closed_reasons: No on-chain guardian, veto, security council or cancel role: verified RadworksGovernor source + guardian()/veto()/securityCouncil()/owner() all revert; only the proposer can cancel while Pending.
Treasury RAD is undelegated: RAD.delegates(timelock)=0x0 and RAD.getPriorVotes(timelock, block-1)=0, so the treasury cannot vote to defend itself.

The timelock is the Governor's executor and holds 40,922,601.104474 RAD + 319,133.030979 USDC + 59.9 WETH + 500,000 GTC + 0.09816 ETH + 99.9958% of the Uniswap V2 RAD/USDC LP (3,788,431 RAD + 1,079,429 USDC).
No active hostile proposal today: 8 ProposalCreated events, all terminal (states 2/3/6/7), last executed 2026-04-25.
The main defense is voluntary delegate voting: Drips 7,105,352 RAD + core delegates ~4.2M RAD. If they vote No, the attacker needs >11.3M RAD and $4M-$6M; the 4M quorum is not enough.
The 0x2887 2-of-3 Safe holds 3,211,112 RAD but has never voted; if it joins the defense the bar rises to ~14.5M RAD.
Direct allowance path checked: only 212,600 RAD allowance to AddLiquidity; addLiquidity() uses transferFrom(msg.sender), so it is not externally drainable. All other timelock allowances are 0.
Drips.withdraw() public excess is dust (~$0.007 USDC), not a direct drain; the Drips TVL is drainable only through the timelock's admin upgrade right.
No V3 NFT positions, no value in the old Sale contract 0x864fdef9..., no other non-spam treasury assets beyond RAD/USDC/WETH/GTC/ETH/LP.
The 5.4-5.5 day path cannot be shortened by the attacker: votingDelay 7,200 blocks, votingPeriod 17,280 blocks, timelock delay 172,800s.

The treasury owns 99.9958% of the only DEX pool, so the DEX leg of the attacker's RAD purchase is paid to the timelock's own LP and is recovered if the attacker captures the LP in the same proposal; the permanent cost is the CEX/OTC leg only.
PoC: 8/8 tests pass at fork block 26,229,556; full path gas 1,389,233; attacker ends with 48,711,032.524060924402470682 RAD + 1,398,562.164486 USDC; Drips admin handover gas 673,255.
No mainnet transactions; all state changes are local-fork only.
caveats: Point-in-time 2026-10-19/20; Drips/core delegate behavior and RAD liquidity must be re-checked before any action. The attack is capital-gated, not privilege-gated.

The $3.0M central net is a scenario-weighted estimate (A 35% / B 20% / C 40% / D 5%) and depends on the RAD liquidation realization (30-40% of spot) and on whether Drips/core delegates vote No. It is not a market quote.

44,711,033 RAD is 75.7% of circulating supply; DEX/CEX depth cannot absorb it at spot. The 50-70% haircut (30-50% realization) is the optimistic-to-central case; a 90% drawdown (10% realization) leaves only ~$0.08M expected net.
Binance's order book was not retrievable from this environment (geo/API block); MEXC/Gate books are thin and may not represent Binance depth. Aggregate 24h volume is the better liquidity proxy.

Drips TVL is mark-to-market at approximate token prices; the Drips drain requires a UUPS upgrade. The PoC proves the admin handover (proposeNewAdmin + acceptAdmin), not the final malicious implementation, due to a public-RPC vm.etch limitation at the pinned historical block.
The top-600 holder scan covers 99.58% of supply; 417k RAD outside the scan could include additional delegated votes. Top delegates were cross-checked with getCurrentVotes().

The pass-2 brief's $11.98M treasury and $3.5M-$6M net are corrected: treasury $14.40M, net central ~$3.0M (unopposed case can reach ~$4.5M; contested case ~$0.1M-$1.4M). The 4M quorum is not the contested-vote cost.
No secrets or keyed RPC URLs are stored in this folder; all work read-only.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can capture the Radworks timelock: buy ~4M RAD (1.3-2.5M USD; ~11.3M RAD / 4-6M USD if Drips+core oppose), propose a transfer of the undelegated 40.92M RAD + 319k USDC + 59.9 WETH + 500k GTC + 99.996% of the RAD/USDC LP, vote, queue, and execute in ~5.4 days with no guardian; gross ~$14.76M (corrected from $11.98M), realistic net ~$3.0M (range $1.4-5.2M), and the same proposal can hand over Drips admin (~$0.36M).
recommendation: KEEP AS CRITICAL (E-U). Immediately delegate the treasury's 40.9M RAD to a defensive delegate and add a guardian/security council with cancel power; raise the proposal threshold to >=4M RAD; move Drips admin off the timelock.
